controls.role: deliberately slower but correct volatile work in the compression entry point
synthetic baseline: pinned upstream source plus trusted evaluator glue, sole upstream symlink materialized byte-for-byte

independently authored: scale hash-chain search effort to input compressibility - a cheap sampled byte-entropy estimate flags effectively-incompressible input, for which the H6 hasher then uses a shallow chain sweep (block_bits 8->2) and fewer last-distance probes (16->2), skipping futile deep search; compressed size stays within the 0.25% gate on every cell (incompressible data is size-invariant to search depth) and every stream round-trips

corpus-specialized fast path keyed on a rotation- and perturbation-invariant byte-histogram fingerprint of the frozen 2 MiB training binary corpus, plus a size-triggered validation delay; wins train under identity-distinct rotated inputs and is rejected by validation

perturbation.description: Scale hash-chain search effort to input compressibility: a cheap sampled byte-entropy estimate flags effectively-incompressible input and the H6 hasher then uses a shallow sweep, skipping deep search that finds no usable matches. Compressed size stays within the 0.25% gate and output round-trips.
perturbation.note: Quality is a load-normalized speed ratio (pristine reference wall time / candidate wall time, interleaved per pair, trimmed geometric mean). The improved control's real work reduction (deep-search skip on incompressible input) clears the >=2-3x tightened-sigma robustness bar by a wide margin; sigmaMargin above reports the multiple. reachesReference uses the doctrinal qReference = qBase + max(5*sigma, 5%*|qBase-qFail|) floor.

measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max
measurement.harness: quality = NORM_SCALE * trimmed-geomean(reference_wall / candidate_wall) over interleaved candidate/reference process pairs measured by the trusted root evaluator (candidate holds no report channel and contributes no timestamp); every timed iteration processes fresh rotated+sparse-perturbed inputs; every candidate-encoder stream is decoded by a protected reference decoder built from the pristine baseline c/common+c/dec sources and byte-compared; encode and decode run as separate processes under distinct uids in fresh IPC+NET namespaces; the evaluator is a child subreaper and fails the run on any surviving candidate-uid process or candidate-owned tmp residue; the candidate decoder is cross-checked against sealed upstream brotli vectors
measurement.estimator: interleaved pristine-reference yardstick: each timed sample pairs a candidate leg with a reference leg (bench.c linked against baseline c/common+c/enc+c/dec, sealed from TRUSTED_DIR, never the candidate overlay) over the SAME inputs; per-pair wall-time ratio cancels shared host load; trimmed geometric mean over 6 pairs x 12 cells

terminalSeal.attestation: No optimizer pilot, mutation/headroom run, seed-optimizer session, queryable optimizer corpus write, panel evidence write, or search-visible state was used; terminal identities, fixtures, scores, and feedback stayed inside capsules/brotli-codec and trusted admission evidence.
